paragraphs: Every day is busy for me. I always wake up at a quarter past six. At half past six, I have a shower. I eat breakfast with Mom and Dad at twenty to seven. I am always hungry in the morning. Mom makes rice and eggs for me. At twenty past seven, I run to the bus stop. Tom is there, too. We talk about football on the bus. We take the bus to school. School starts at eight o'clock.

We have a break at five past ten. I play football with my friends. In class, we write and draw. Lunch is at a quarter to twelve. After lunch, we read a book. School ends at a quarter past three. I am tired, but I am happy. I get home at ten to four.

Before dinner, I do my homework. Dinner is at six o'clock. I eat rice and fish with my family. After dinner, I read with Dad. I go to bed at half past eight. How do I know the time? I look at the clock on my wall. Do you have a clock in your room? Look at your clock now. What is the time?
text.summary: Ben tells about his school day from the morning to the evening. He says each time with clock words.
